data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: After sentinel exists, read-config.sh <legacy-key> exits non-zero with recovery command (test side)
- DD2: read-config.sh dso.workflow continues normally after sentinel (test side)

## Implementation Notes
Add new test cases to tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh. These tests MUST FAIL (RED) before Task 2 is implemented.

All tests use mktemp fixtures and set WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE to bypass git-root resolution where appropriate. For sentinel tests, create a temporary git repo via `git init`, set up `.claude/dso-config.conf` with a legacy key, and create `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` sentinel.

Test cases to add:
1. `test_sentinel_lockout_exits_nonzero` — Given sentinel file exists AND legacy key is `merge.strategy` in a fixture git repo; When `read-config.sh merge.strategy` is called (without WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE, so git-root resolution fires); Then exits 1 AND stderr contains both "Legacy key" and the recovery command (e.g., "git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf")
2. `test_sentinel_lockout_all_four_legacy_keys` — Same sentinel fixture; assert exit 1 for each of `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`
3. `test_sentinel_lockout_dso_workflow_unaffected` — Same sentinel fixture; When `dso.workflow` is read; Then exits 0 with normal output
4. `test_sentinel_absent_legacy_key_reads_normally` — Same fixture but WITHOUT sentinel file; When `merge.strategy` is read; Then exits 0 with expected value (legacy keys still work pre-migration)
5. `test_sentinel_fail_open_when_no_git_root` — Use WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a tmp conf with a legacy key but running outside any git repo (cd /tmp); lockout must NOT fire; exits 0

Update .test-index with RED markers for each new test function:
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh:[test_sentinel_lockout_exits_nonzero] tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh:[test_sentinel_lockout_all_four_legacy_keys] tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh:[test_sentinel_lockout_dso_workflow_unaffected] tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh:[test_sentinel_absent_legacy_key_reads_normally] tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh:[test_sentinel_fail_open_when_no_git_root] tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh

## TDD Requirement
RED test task — write tests that FAIL before implementation. Verify RED state: run `bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh`; the five new test assertions must fail (FAIL: lines emitted). Commit with RED markers in .test-index.

Given: a fixture git repo containing `.claude/dso-config.conf` with `merge.strategy=direct` AND `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` sentinel file
When: `read-config.sh merge.strategy` is invoked (no WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE override, running inside the git repo)
Then: exit code 1 AND stderr contains "Legacy key" AND stderr contains a recovery command string

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass after Task 2 is implemented (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] Five new test functions are present in test-read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -c "test_sentinel_lockout\|test_sentinel_absent\|test_sentinel_fail_open" tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] New test functions currently fail RED (before Task 2 implementation)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL:.*sentinel'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for all five new test functions
  Verify: grep -c '\[test_sentinel' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index" | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] test_sentinel_lockout_exits_nonzero asserts exit code 1 (not just stderr)
  Verify: grep -A5 'test_sentinel_lockout_exits_nonzero' tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh | grep -q 'exit\|nonzero\|ne 0'
- [ ] test_sentinel_fail_open_when_no_git_root asserts exit 0 (fail-open path)
  Verify: grep -A5 'test_sentinel_fail_open_when_no_git_root' tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh | grep -q 'exit.*0\|graceful\|zero'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Write RED tests for sentinel lockout in test-read-config.sh
